anti_patterns.description: Manual blur does not respect system accessibility overrides
anti_patterns.notes: Replace manual .blur(radius:) with native .glassEffect() API. Manual blurs ignore Reduce Transparency and Increase Contrast settings.

anti_patterns.description: Hard-coded opacity overlay may conflict with Liquid Glass
anti_patterns.notes: Hard-coded .opacity() overlays on backgrounds bypass system accessibility. Use native glass materials instead.

anti_patterns.description: UIVisualEffectView should be replaced with Liquid Glass
anti_patterns.notes: UIVisualEffectView is a legacy blur mechanism. Migrate to SwiftUI Liquid Glass APIs.

anti_patterns.description: UIBlurEffect should be replaced with Liquid Glass
anti_patterns.notes: UIBlurEffect is the UIKit legacy blur. Use native .glassEffect() for iOS 26.

anti_patterns.description: UIVibrancyEffect should migrate to Liquid Glass
anti_patterns.notes: UIVibrancyEffect is legacy. Liquid Glass handles vibrancy natively.
